Original_Claim_Text: High-dimensional consensus clustering frequently exhibits severe stability-accuracy discordance where subsample stability is high while accuracy is near chance.
Evidence_Basis: Across 9 non-degenerate cells (FCAG, FCM, FastMVC on 3 cohorts each), mean stability is 0.684, mean accuracy is -0.003, and null stability is +0.012. Across all 72 cells, mean gap is +0.464 (95% bootstrap CI [+0.407, +0.521]).
Statistical_Adjustment: None needed. Preserved as core verified thesis.
Actionable_Recommendation: Retain as central verified contribution of the manuscript.

Original_Claim_Text: Column-permuted null controls establish that subsample stability on discordant partitions reflects genuine multivariately-driven structure rather than algorithmic artifact.
Evidence_Basis: Permuted null stability averages +0.0066 across all 72 cells and +0.0118 across the 9 discordant cells, remaining near zero while unpermuted stability reaches 0.684-0.905.
Actionable_Recommendation: Maintain as primary methodological safeguard distinguishing genuine data structure from trivial consensus traps.

Original_Claim_Text: Decision Rule (i') successfully separates genuine non-degenerate discordance from trivial singleton or near-constant cluster collapses.
Evidence_Basis: Correctly flags Core-Halo on Prostate (K_obs=1.0) and CoHiRF on Prostate (60% singleton collapse), filtering out mathematical degeneracy.
Statistical_Adjustment: Acknowledge in text that Rule (i') was added as an empirical safeguard post-hoc after observing trivial singletons in early runs.
Actionable_Recommendation: Clearly document the non-degeneracy threshold (<5% minority cluster in >10% subsamples) as a pre-requisite for discordance claims.

Original_Claim_Text: AutoK provides distribution-free PAC guarantees for cluster count estimation with finite-sample bounds.
Evidence_Basis: In 510/510 adversarial trials (100%), AutoK collapsed to K_min=2; in 486/510 (95.3%), all PAC non-conformity scores were identically zero.
Statistical_Adjustment: Remove PAC theoretical guarantee claims entirely; report empirical collapse.
Actionable_Recommendation: Withdraw AutoK as a standalone theoretical contribution; treat cluster count K as known or benchmarked across fixed grids.

Original_Claim_Text: All components of ICC-v2 (gating, anchor graph, conformal calibration) are statistically necessary for performance.
Evidence_Basis: Wilcoxon signed-rank tests across the 6 high-D cohorts yield raw p >= 0.156, Bonferroni p_adj >= 0.469, Holm-Bonferroni p_adj >= 0.938. None reach statistical significance.
Statistical_Adjustment: Correct claims from statistically significant necessity to observed empirical mean gain concentrated in specific multimodal cohorts.
Actionable_Recommendation: State clearly that while full GAC achieves highest mean ARI (0.226 vs 0.033-0.095), pairwise contrasts across 6 cohorts do not reach statistical significance.

Original_Claim_Text: GAC provides a consistent performance gain across all high-dimensional biomedical cohorts.
Evidence_Basis: GAC advantage is overwhelmingly concentrated in Leukemia (+0.566) and SRBCT (+0.499). On the other 4 cohorts (CNS, Colon, Ovarian, Prostate), the mean gain over baseline is only +0.024.
Statistical_Adjustment: Explicitly disclose the cohort heterogeneity and report stratified means with and without Leukemia/SRBCT.
Actionable_Recommendation: Frame GAC as an effective architecture specifically for cohorts with distinct bimodal margin separation (e.g. Leukemia, SRBCT), rather than universal superiority.

Original_Claim_Text: ICC-v2 outperforms 11 state-of-the-art and classical clustering baselines across 13 diverse benchmarks.
Evidence_Basis: Across all 13 benchmarks, ICC-v2 ranks 4th (mean rank 5.615), behind K-Means (5.154), Standard Consensus (5.231), and DEC (5.231). Friedman test p = 0.398 (non-significant).
Statistical_Adjustment: Withdraw claim of global benchmark supremacy across general data domains.
Actionable_Recommendation: Highlight that GAC is tailored for high-dimensional regimes (D/N > 20) where it ranks 1st (mean rank 2.167), but performs comparably to standard algorithms on low-D datasets.

Original_Claim_Text: ICC-v2 achieves top-ranked clustering accuracy across the six high-dimensional biomedical cohorts.
Evidence_Basis: ICC-v2 ranks 1st with mean rank 2.167 (mean ARI 0.217 vs 0.046-0.124 for baselines). However, omnibus Friedman p = 0.272 due to n=6 sample size.
Statistical_Adjustment: Report the 1st place mean rank alongside the non-significant Friedman test p=0.272.
Actionable_Recommendation: Present rank 2.167 as strong directional evidence in the high-D domain while acknowledging statistical power limitations of n=6 datasets.

Original_Claim_Text: GAC achieves statistically significant improvement on SRBCT with p = 0.03125.
Evidence_Basis: The calculation p = 0.03125 on n=5 seeds (W=15) is strictly one-sided. The valid two-sided exact p-value is p = 0.0625, which is not significant at alpha = 0.05.
Statistical_Adjustment: Report two-sided p = 0.0625 and note it as marginally significant or trend-level.
Actionable_Recommendation: Correct the p-value in audit files and ensure manuscript does not claim significance at 0.05 level on 5 seeds.

Evidence_Basis: The reported interval violates the bounded domain [0, 1] of ARI on this dataset due to naive Student-t distribution on n=5 seeds. Percentile bootstrap CI is [0.0076, 0.8879].
Statistical_Adjustment: Replace Student-t interval with non-parametric percentile bootstrap CI.
Actionable_Recommendation: Update summary tables and text with proper bounded bootstrap intervals.

Original_Claim_Text: Bipartite anchor graph consensus enables sub-quadratic time and memory scaling in sample size N.
Evidence_Basis: Memory scales as O(N * M) rather than O(N^2). Empirical peak RSS is 142 MB at N=500 and 846 MB at N=10,000, avoiding the 800 MB - 20 GB matrix required by full consensus.
Statistical_Adjustment: Ensure complexity formula separates graph construction O(N*M*d) from anchor SVD O(M^3).
Actionable_Recommendation: Retain as a core verified engineering strength of the pipeline.

Original_Claim_Text: Anchor projection enables accurate inductive out-of-sample label assignment for unseen test points.
Evidence_Basis: Train/test split evaluation across 140 fits in results.json demonstrates inductive test ARI tracking transductive train ARI within 5-8% margin.
Statistical_Adjustment: Clarify that inductive projection requires anchors to adequately cover test distribution support.
Actionable_Recommendation: Retain with clear assumptions regarding out-of-sample covariate shift.
